_comment: B-tier shared case table for the ONE whole-file env-line grammar (v0.2.102 W6-Z1). Python home: vco_lib/envfile.py (parse_env_line; env_value(..., last_wins=True)). Rust mirror: launcher/src-tauri/vct-launcher-core/src/services/env_file.rs (parse_env_line; read_key). Rule: strip the line; drop an optional `export ` prefix; skip blank / `#` / no-`=` lines; split on the FIRST `=`; trim key and value; strip ONE matching quote pair (no escape reversal, no expansion). Whole-file reads: LAST assignment wins. `managed_block_env` is the input whose _build_managed_block output appears in the files cases (tests/test_v02102_env_line_grammar_parity.py fails if the writer's bytes drift).

export KG_COLLECTION="Alpha_KnowledgeGraph"
# vco-managed-end
